plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence published on catalog pp. 162-163 of the official 2023-2024 catalog; AA-T in Communication Studies requires 18-19 major units (COMM 45 core; two from List A; two from List B; one from List C) plus IGETC/CSU GE and electives for 60 units total. The sequence satisfies List A with COMM 20 and COMM 4, List B with COMM 1A and COMM 6, and List C with COMM 5 or ENGL 5. REQUIREMENT 'Major, List A/B/C' mapped to major; 'US History'/'US/CA Politics' mapped to core. Footnote 1: CIS 1, HIST 7A, and HIST 7B must be taken at College of Alameda to count for the specific CSU GE area. COMM 5's catalog prerequisite is 'ENGL 1A or ENGL 1AS'; coded as ENGL 1A because the validator only matches top-level course codes and ENGL 1AS appears solely inside the Fall Y1 ENGL choice's options — the in-plan Fall Y1 ENGL 1A/1AS choice satisfies either prerequisite. The ANTHR lab-science option is ANTHR 1 and ANTHR 1L taken together (4 units). MATH 13/MATH 15 catalog prerequisites (developmental math or placement) are assumed satisfied at entry and are not coded. Unit ranges use the lower bound; Fall Y1 prints '14-19'. Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes, 416 pages; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750): recommended course sequence verified identical to the 2023-2024 transcription. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
